definitions.explanation: An angle measuring less than 90 degrees.

examples.japanese: {鋭角|えいかく}は90{度|ど}{未満|みまん}の{角|かく}だ。
examples.english: An acute angle is an angle less than 90 degrees.

examples.japanese: この{三角形|さんかくけい}は{全|すべ}ての{角|かく}が{鋭角|えいかく}だ。
examples.english: All angles in this triangle are acute angles.

examples.japanese: 45{度|ど}は{鋭角|えいかく}の{一例|いちれい}だ。
examples.english: 45 degrees is an example of an acute angle.

notes:
{鋭角|えいかく} is an angle less than 90 degrees. It contrasts with {直角|ちょっかく} (right angle) and {鈍角|どんかく} (obtuse angle).

ANGLE TYPES:
- {鋭角|えいかく}: acute angle (0° < θ < 90°)
- {直角|ちょっかく}: right angle (θ = 90°)
- {鈍角|どんかく}: obtuse angle (90° < θ < 180°)

RELATED TERMS:
- {鋭角|えいかく}{三角形|さんかくけい}: acute triangle (all angles acute)
